description: Kukoo2 by Type One of The FLamoots, an advertising intro for the Pleasure Access BBS in Brussels, with AdLib music, running from its original files in your browser.
about: Kukoo2 is the advertising intro Type One of The FLamoots wrote for the Pleasure Access BBS, a board in Brussels, first released in January 1994. This is version 2.43 “short”, of 28 March 1994.

A CGA pre-intro comes first, with the Belgian national anthem on the PC speaker, and waits for Space at its end. Its VGA part, with AdLib music, then loops until Space or Escape, and an ANSI screen follows, which Space or Escape again ends.
In 2022 Type One published its source and a rebuild under an MIT license. DosKit runs the 1994 build.
released: First released in January 1994; version 2.43 “short” is dated 28 March 1994. It was not made for a party.
credits: Code by Type One; the pre-intro's idea and graphics by Fred. Music: “Crooner” by Drax (Thomas Mogensen), converted by JCH of Vibrants and played by JCH's AdLib player, with an interface by Patch of Avalanche. Font by Witan, from their demo Facts of Life.

It cannot cover JCH's AdLib player, Drax's tune or Witan's font, which the intro took from others: it says “VIBRANTS (sorry for ripping your rout !!!)”.
accuracy: It runs on a plain VGA (DOSBox's vgaonly), as its author's README asks: on DOSBox's default SVGA card its VGA part is garbled. Reds and blues then have half the shades.
Its VGA part uses a mode of its author's own, larger than the usual to fill a CRT to its edges; DosKit shows it at 792x558.
Its AdLib music plays through the Sound Blaster's OPL, and the pre-intro's anthem through the PC speaker.
Not yet compared with a capture made on real hardware.
